races.name: CopyBet Overnight Best Odds Guaranteed Novices' Handicap Steeple Chase

runners_data.name: Kenzo Des Bruyeres
runners_data.note: Sole front-runner with a confirmed lead-from-the-front style; James Bowen and Mickey Bowen combine well as a family team, the Good ground suits, and the 22-day turnaround is sharp — his recent form shows no wins in similar going but finishing positions are skewed by class steps up; the uncontested lead here is a significant upgrade in conditions.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts, Kenzo Des Bruyeres nevertheless heads the ratings and brings distance and going experience to the table, with a 22-day turnaround leaving him fresh under 166 lb — though he will need to find improvement on recent efforts to settle matters here.

runners_data.name: Swingforthefence
runners_data.note: Hold-up operator for Jennie Candlish fitted with tongue-strap, returning after 50 days off; best form has come on Good ground (one place from four similar-going runs) but has not raced beyond 20f in recent outings, making this 2m7f trip a stamina question that the pace scenario needs to answer for him.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts and unseated on his most recent outing, Swingforthefence arrives 50 days fresh and has run over today's going before, with our rating matching his official mark of 90 and placing him second among these six — though that recent departure is the obvious concern.

runners_data.name: Broadway Honey
runners_data.note: Consistent if frustrating for Sam Twiston-Davies and the Twiston-Davies yard — five placed efforts in last eight Good-ground starts but no wins; the 99-day absence is a concern, and a horse that settles at the rear will need this to develop into a true test of stamina to get competitive at the business end.
runners_data.comment: Broadway Honey showed her best when third five starts back, and her experience on today's going keeps her firmly in the mix despite carrying 162 lb; the main concern is a run coming after 99 days off the track.

runners_data.name: Izzy's Grey
runners_data.note: Belinda Clarke's mare has been in good form with three places from fifteen Good-ground efforts and goes well fresh (48-day break); she is a true hold-up type by nature, and while the race map places her in midfield due to field composition, she will instinctively race further back — tongue-strap fitted, and her chance depends on whether the pace is hot enough to bring her into it late.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts and ranked fifth of six on our figures, Izzy's Grey is hard to fancy, though he has run over today's trip and going before and that runner-up finish two starts back shows some ability worth noting.

runners_data.name: Jo Arengeot Bey AA
runners_data.note: Gavin Sheehan partners a horse in cracking recent form — a win and two places in last four starts, all on Good ground, and the 2m6f win in his last victory shows this trip holds no fears; Donald McCain's runner is 13 days fresh and wears a visor, and his prominent style makes him the most dangerous individual rival to the leader if the pace is sustainable.
runners_data.comment: Sharp recent form makes Jo Arengeot Bey AA a genuine threat here — third last time out and a winner four starts back, returning fit on 13 days' rest and with experience of today's trip and going; the pulled-up run three starts back is the one to forgive.

runners_data.name: Man Oh Man
runners_data.note: Bryan Carver rides a horse that has posted four placed efforts from eleven Good-ground runs and was second over 2m6f on similar going — the trip clearly suits; a genuine hold-up type placed in the midfield by the race map due to overcrowding at the rear, he will need things to fall perfectly and the pace to be searching to land a blow from his natural position.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last six starts and ranked last on our figures, Man Oh Man is hard to fancy at 156 lb, though he does return on a quick 14-day turnaround with experience of today's trip and going, and a second last time out offers a slender crumb of encouragement.

races.paceDynamic: Kenzo Des Bruyeres is the sole confirmed front-runner in this six-runner field and faces no genuine pace rival to force him off his rhythm, meaning he is almost certain to dictate terms at whatever tempo suits James Bowen over this 2m7f trip on Good ground. Jo Arengeot Bey AA will track from a prominent position and represents the only horse likely to apply any sustained pressure from close range, while Broadway Honey, Swingforthefence, Izzy's Grey and Man Oh Man all prefer to race further back. This setup hands Kenzo Des Bruyeres a free lead and the ability to control tempo — historically the profile most dangerous on a fair surface at Worcester over a staying trip when the gallop is honest but uncontested. Izzy's Grey and Man Oh Man are genuine hold-up horses shuffled into the midfield position on the map simply because the field contains more hold-up types than the race shape can accommodate at the rear — neither is likely to race forward of where their instincts place them, reinforcing that the backmarkers will have genuine ground to make up late. The race shape strongly favours front-running and prominent horses, particularly any that can either control the race or closely track the leader without being drawn into a duel.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Kenzo Controls Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Kenzo Des Bruyeres bowls along at a measured pace and no horse applies serious pressure from the front.
scenarios.body: Kenzo Des Bruyeres sets a controlled gallop that suits his stamina profile over the 2m7f trip, and with Jo Arengeot Bey AA the only horse close enough to threaten, the leader can quicken or simply stay on grimly when the race enters its final mile.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Horse Pounces Late
scenarios.trigger: If Kenzo Des Bruyeres is caught out by a collapse in jumping or stamina in the final half-mile.
scenarios.body: Jo Arengeot Bey AA, hunting close throughout, is perfectly placed to strike at the last as the leader weakens, having shown a win and three placed efforts in Good-ground staying events in recent form.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is strong enough and sustained long enough to set up a late run from the rear.
scenarios.body: Swingforthefence or Broadway Honey would need a genuine end-to-end gallop to generate the momentum for a closing surge, but both are out of their natural position and face a lot of ground to make up over a track that rarely rewards pure closers.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos And Attrition
scenarios.trigger: If multiple fallers, unseated riders or jumping errors shake up the race and remove the fancied horses from contention.
scenarios.body: Man Oh Man and Izzy's Grey, both redistributed hold-up types with strong placed records, could benefit from a scrambled finish if the leaders cut each other out of the race or fall at late fences.

watchPoints.text: Watch Kenzo Des Bruyeres's jumping at the early fences — if he makes a serious error in the first circuit he surrenders the primary advantage this race shape gives him and the entire dynamic shifts to Jo Arengeot Bey AA.

Jo Arengeot Bey AA's visor and 13-day quick turnaround is worth monitoring in the paddock — if he travels freely and tracks Kenzo within two lengths turning for home, he becomes a live danger regardless of the leader's stamina.

Broadway Honey's 99-day absence for the Twiston-Davies yard is the most significant fitness question in the race — if she moves poorly in the early stages it flags she is not wound up enough to matter over this distance.

Izzy's Grey and Man Oh Man are both natural hold-up horses mapped to midfield — watch whether either jockey attempts to push forward at the start, as any unexpected position change would materially alter which scenario plays out.
The Good ground is confirmed throughout the card at Worcester today — no horse carries a going concern, so the race should be run on its merits without late ground-related excuses.

races.name: FBC Manby Bowdler Handicap Steeple Chase (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Crebilly
runners_data.note: Won over 20f on good going and has placed multiple times at a similar distance; Harry Cobden is a key booking and the hood (hg:p) is retained — a genuine hold-up horse who needs a clean run through traffic to deliver his finishing effort.
runners_data.comment: Winner three starts back and placed last time out, Crebilly arrives here in solid heart after 21 days off, with experience of today's trip and going working in his favour; carrying 168 lb is the one test, but at a rating of 136 he heads this five-runner field as the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Snipe
runners_data.note: Harry Skelton and Dan Skelton are a powerful combination and recent form shows a win last time, but 106 days off is a flag; his true racing style is hold-up, and with several rivals seeking the same rear berth, he may be forced closer to the pace than his record suggests he prefers.
runners_data.comment: Snipe was a winner three starts back and ran a solid second last time out, bringing strong recent form into this; the concern is a return from 106 days off, though his trainer is in excellent nick at 36% over the past fortnight.

runners_data.name: Karnaval Point
runners_data.note: David Pipe's runner goes in a tongue-tie and has won twice in the last five starts including a course-relevant 24f win on good ground; with only a 5lb claimer for ballast, his ability to control from the front at this weight makes him the race-shaper — the STYLE_FIT tag is a mild caution, not a disqualifier.

runners_data.name: Glen To Glen
runners_data.note: Nick Scholfield's four-year-old is lightly raced over fences and last ran just five days ago, which warrants monitoring for freshness; a winner over 20f on good ground, he is a natural hold-up type who can produce a strong closing effort if able to find daylight, though his jumping must be trusted under pressure.
runners_data.comment: Glen To Glen is a dual winner in recent starts and has experience of today's trip and conditions, giving him a strong profile at 160 lb; the only concern is a refusal two starts back, which must be forgiven if he is to deliver on his clear ability.

runners_data.name: Youdecide
runners_data.note: Two wins from his last two starts over similar distances on good ground give Ben Pauling's gelding strong current form; a prominent racer who is likely to stalk Karnaval Point, his low weight of 149lbs is an asset and the STYLE_FIT caveat simply reflects that he cannot always guarantee the position he needs.
runners_data.comment: Youdecide has won his last two starts and returns on a quick 13-day turnaround with distance and going experience in his favour, but a pulled-up run three starts back is a concern and our figures rank him last of the five runners here.

races.paceDynamic: Karnaval Point is the one confirmed front-runner in this five-runner field and, with only Youdecide as a potential prominent companion, faces no genuine pressure for the lead — he can dictate a controlled, honest gallop throughout the 2m4f trip on good ground at Worcester. Crebilly, Glen To Glen, and Snipe are all hold-up types who will track from off the pace, though the field contains more genuine hold-up horses than can all naturally fill the rear positions, meaning the race shape at the back will be congested. Youdecide has shown prominent tendencies and is likely to sit just behind Karnaval Point, giving the leader a loose but not wholly uncontested hand. This race shape — a single, unchallenged front-runner setting a sustainable pace on good ground — strongly favours hold-up horses with a clean turn of foot in the straight, particularly those who can deliver a single powerful challenge rather than being caught in traffic in a compressed field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Karnaval Point Controls Cleanly
scenarios.trigger: If Karnaval Point leads comfortably and sets a steady, uncontested gallop that stretches the hold-up horses before the final turn.
scenarios.body: Karnaval Point dictates every yard of the race at a controlled tempo, and the hold-up horses are forced to produce their challenges simultaneously in the straight — only the sharpest finisher can peg him back.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Hold-Up Surge
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is genuinely fast enough to soften Karnaval Point and allow a well-timed hold-up finisher to sweep past in the final stages.
scenarios.body: A competitive gallop drains the front-runner late, and the horse tracking closest to the pace rather than hunting from deep earns the best position to pounce; Crebilly's good-ground form and course profile suit this shape.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Youdecide Prominent Ambush
scenarios.trigger: If Youdecide tracks Karnaval Point closely throughout and produces a prominent challenge from the second fence out.
scenarios.body: Youdecide's back-to-back wins suggest a horse coming to peak form, and a prominent ride from Ben Jones shadowing the leader could expose any weakness in Karnaval Point at the top of the straight.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos Disrupts Shape
scenarios.trigger: If jumping errors or fallers disrupt the field order and remove the lone pace influence, forcing an unpredictable scramble.
scenarios.body: With several hold-up horses bunched and unlikely to have settled cleanly, any interference could produce a muddled race where positional luck and jumping cleanness matter most.

watchPoints.text: Karnaval Point's jumping must be monitored — if Rian Corcoran (5lb claim) errs at any of the early fences, the entire race shape collapses and the hold-up brigade have a chaotic race to navigate.

Snipe's 106-day absence is a significant fitness question; if Dan Skelton's horse is not at peak sharpness, his ability to pick up off a steady gallop is compromised, making any hold-up scenario that relies on him unreliable.
Glen To Glen ran only five days ago — watch the paddock for signs of fatigue or any veterinary concern, particularly given his jumping is still being tested at this level.

With three genuine hold-up types (Crebilly, Snipe, Glen To Glen) all wanting the same rear positions, the order they settle into during the first mile will have a significant bearing on which one gets the clearest run into the straight.

Good ground is confirmed across all races today at Worcester — no runner faces a going concern, meaning the race is decided purely on shape, fitness, and jumping, removing any softening excuse for poor performances.

races.name: Step Into Luxury With Purple Granite Open National Hunt Flat Race (Category 1 Elimination) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Chase The Status
runners_data.comment: Unexposed and open to improvement, Chase The Status showed ability with a third last time out, though he is yet to win in recent starts; returning after 159 days off carrying 156 lb, there is clearly more to come from this lightly raced gelding.

runners_data.name: Jaunty Trooper
runners_data.comment: Jaunty Trooper has run over today's trip and going, arrives fit on an 18-day turnaround, and a rating of 104 ranks him third in this field of nine — a genuine threat; the main concern is that recent starts have left him yet to win and include an unseating.

runners_data.name: Spanish Darling
runners_data.comment: Winning back-to-back two and three starts back, Spanish Darling arrives in cracking nick on a short 18-day turnaround, has run over today's trip and going, and at 156 lb his rating of 110 marks him as the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Wannabe Sporty
runners_data.comment: Unexposed on debut, Wannabe Sporty carries 154 lb and, with nothing yet in the book, remains entirely open to improvement on whatever he produces here.

runners_data.name: Gilwen Georgia
runners_data.comment: Unexposed on debut, Gilwen Georgia is yet to score but lightly raced and open to significant improvement; carrying 149 lb, she represents an unknown quantity with plenty still to find out about her.

runners_data.name: Delulu
runners_data.comment: Delulu shaped well when runner-up last time out, and with experience over today's trip and going, she arrives here fit on an 18-day turnaround; a trainer firing at 36% makes her a lively threat, though she remains yet to score.

runners_data.name: Emilyfromtheknoll
runners_data.comment: Unraced and completely unexposed, Emilyfromtheknoll steps into the unknown on debut carrying 147 lb, with an open profile that leaves plenty of room for improvement on whatever she shows here.

runners_data.name: Lizziemouth
runners_data.comment: Unraced and therefore unexposed, Lizziemouth makes her debut carrying 147 lb, with her ability entirely unknown but the scope for improvement wide open.

runners_data.name: Megatothemax
runners_data.comment: Megatothemax shaped with promise when third two starts back and returns in good order after just 13 days, her experience over today's trip and going a clear asset at a rating of 99; the concern is a sixth last time out suggests she must bounce back sharply.

races.name: CopyBet Follow Us On X Maiden Hurdle Race (ARC Summer Novices' Brush Hurdle Qualifier) (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Baltic
runners_data.note: Handled Good ground three starts ago for a third but best form is over 14f+ and the step back to 2m is a question mark; a natural deep closer who will be ridden further forward than ideal given the field's composition, limiting late impact.

runners_data.name: Billy Butcher
runners_data.note: Returns from 701 days off for Dave Roberts (0/2 in 14 days) with zero placed runs at this distance and going — a come-from-behind operator who will struggle to find his natural rhythm in a race where the tail is crowded.

runners_data.name: Bluey Bay
runners_data.note: Keighley's other runner carries a poor recent string (550P-) and all form came on Soft ground, so Good conditions here represent a genuine query; hold-up style unlikely to be rewarded by the expected steady pace.

runners_data.name: Emerald Tir
runners_data.note: Lightly raced with just one run to his name, a fourth on Good going over this exact trip, so the form line is honest if sparse; Ryan Hatch yard (0/2 in 14 days) and an amateur jockey add risk to an intriguing unknown.

runners_data.name: Lock Stock
runners_data.note: Three placed runs over 2m at Goodwood and Worcester on Good and Soft give him legitimate claims as a prominent racer; 258 days off is the concern, but Edmunds has had one winner from four in 14 days and the horse places consistently when fit.

runners_data.name: Thepassingcyclone
runners_data.note: The sole confirmed front-runner — Ffrench Davis sends him here on 109 days off after a string of midfield finishes that undersell his true front-running role; if he jumps and bowls along, the uncontested lead is his, though the STYLE_FIT flag reminds that he has not always reproduced this role.

runners_data.name: Action Replay
runners_data.note: Young four-year-old trained by in-form Longsdon (2/3 in 14 days) with Cobden booked — a significant positive signal; unknown going preference and a fall on debut mean the form is opaque, but the talent angle is real.

runners_data.name: Arbitration
runners_data.note: Consistent placer (two seconds from two hurdle runs, both on Good ground) who stays well and handles this trip — Tizzard yard in modest form (1/3) but Brendan Powell knows the horse and prominent style suits the anticipated pace shape perfectly.

runners_data.name: C'Est Pour Moi
runners_data.note: Three starts, three finishes outside the places for the Twiston-Davies yard, all on Good ground over 2m — the pattern is consistent but consistently disappointing; hood worn last time failed to unlock improvement.

runners_data.name: Giant's Way
runners_data.note: Jonjo Jr. on a prominent-style four-year-old for the in-form O'Neill yard (2/13 in 14 days) — three starts on Good all resulted in fifth or sixth, so ability is there but a winner's instinct is yet to emerge; a tongue-tie was applied last time.

runners_data.name: Savanna Storm
runners_data.note: David Pipe's hold-up type with headgear (h) who has not bettered eighth in three starts — moderate form and a running style that will be compromised by the anticipated steady gallop; Corcoran claim does not compensate.

runners_data.name: Sytadel
runners_data.note: Harry Skelton's booking after 492 days off for in-form Dan Skelton (9/25 in 14 days) is the standout trainer-jockey angle in the race; completely unknown over hurdles but the flat mark will be well above average if it translates, making it a genuine dark horse in Scenario C.

runners_data.name: Teleleo
runners_data.note: Won on debut over C&D on Good going (2m, Worcester) for Keighley, making this a course-and-distance winner stepping up from a recent fourth — Sean Bowen's book, genuine prominent style and the fastest relevant form in the field make him the most compelling pace-shape fit.

runners_data.name: Troy Story
runners_data.note: All five runs on Standard (AW) going — the switch to Good turf at Worcester over 2m hurdles is a completely unknown commodity; no jumping form in the public domain and Roberts yard out of form (0/2 in 14 days).

races.paceDynamic: Thepassingcyclone is the lone confirmed front-runner and, with no rival likely to seriously challenge for the lead, should dictate from the front at a pace entirely of Harry Bannister's choosing — a sustainable, uncontested gallop over 2m on Good ground at Worcester. With 14 runners and a field containing more genuine hold-up types than the track map can accommodate at the rear, Baltic and Billy Butcher are both true come-from-behind horses who are likely to find themselves shuffled into midfield rather than their preferred deep positions, distorting the shape and reducing the likelihood of a true strong-pace scenario that would suit closers. The field also carries several prominent-style horses — Lock Stock, Arbitration, Giant's Way, Teleleo — who will press Thepassingcyclone into the early stages without necessarily burning it up, likely producing a steady-to-moderate tempo that suits those travelling comfortably just off the pace. This race shape strongly favours prominent raiders and patient mid-division types who can settle and produce a sustained finish, rather than pure hold-up horses, who face the double disadvantage of a modest pace and a compromised starting position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Thepassingcyclone Controls Cleanly
scenarios.trigger: If Thepassingcyclone leads uncontested, sets a sustainable gallop, and the prominent horses tracking it lack the finishing kick to peg it back.
scenarios.body: Bannister dictates every yard on a horse that handles Good ground, and the moderate pace means the leader is never truly pressured — it jumps well enough to sustain a rhythm and simply stays on to score. Prominent racers who travel fluently close to the pace — Teleleo, Arbitration, Lock Stock — are the ones best placed to challenge, as they need no big late move.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Chaser Overpowers Leader
scenarios.trigger: If one of the tracking prominent horses — Teleleo, Arbitration or Giant's Way — times a smooth move two out and outstays Thepassingcyclone on the run-in.
scenarios.body: A steady pace means those sitting three to four lengths off the lead travel economically and have petrol left when they ask for an effort jumping the second-last — Worcester's flat finish rewards a sustained gallop rather than a sprint. Teleleo has already won over this C&D trip on Good ground and Arbitration's consistent placed form at this level makes both credible overtakers.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Lightly Raced Type Improves Sharply
scenarios.trigger: If one of the unexposed or returning horses — Sytadel, Action Replay or Emerald Tir — shows markedly improved form on better ground or first hurdling run.
scenarios.body: Sytadel has Skelton confidence behind it and a 492-day absence means its flat benchmark is untested over hurdles — a clean round could see it slot into a pace-suit position and quicken past a tired field. Action Replay, trained by Longsdon whose stable is in form (2/3 over 14 days), is similarly unknown but Cobden's booking signals stable confidence.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Pounce From Deep
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is faster than expected and the field strings out, enabling genuine hold-up types to close from well back on the run-in.
scenarios.body: This scenario requires a tempo increase that current pace evidence does not support, and both Baltic and Billy Butcher — the most natural closers — are likely to be stuck in midfield rather than their preferred stalking ground, blunting their finishing effort. Even if they do get competitive late, Baltic's best form is over longer trips and Billy Butcher returns from 701 days off, making either a winner in this shape a low-probability outcome.

watchPoints.text: Thepassingcyclone jumping: if it flukes an early mistake or is jumped past at the first, the entire pace map dissolves — watch its jumping at the opening hurdle to confirm it leads as expected.

Sytadel on debut for Skelton: a 492-day absence is long but Dan Skelton's 9/25 strike rate in 14 days and Harry Skelton's booking suggest this is not a pipe-opener — a big run on debut would significantly reshape the market live.

Teleleo's stamina reserve: he won over this exact C&D trip but that was his debut and he is now stepping into a competitive 14-runner field — watch whether Bowen gives him daylight from the home turn or gets boxed in on the inside rail.

Baltic and Billy Butcher positioning: both will try to travel closer than their natural hold-up style warrants — if either gets trapped wide and loses ground at the rear, discount them entirely; if they slot mid-division smoothly, they remain live at a price.

Action Replay market moves: Cobden is selective and Longsdon's stable form is good (2/3 in 14 days) — any significant market support pre-race for this unexposed four-year-old should be treated as a meaningful signal.

races.name: PJ Nicholls KGM Korea Genuinely Made Novices' Limited Handicap Hurdle Race

runners_data.name: Daaris
runners_data.note: Seven-year-old hold-up performer whose recent form includes an eighth at 17f on Good; sim-going record of 3/15 with no wins and only two places makes him hard to recommend at this trip, and his jockey Lee Edwards is lightly weighted in this company.
runners_data.comment: Daaris has been knocking on the door with three thirds in recent starts and returns on a quick turnaround of just 13 days, boasting experience on today's going and an encouraging rating of 98; the risk is he has been winless in his last five, and that eighth last time out raises a question about consistency.

runners_data.name: Crafty Gael
runners_data.note: Sean Bowen takes the ride for Olly Murphy (0/10 in 14 days) and this horse has genuine Good-ground experience at 20f+, placing twice in his last five over this course type; a genuine hold-up horse who will need others to do the work before he launches.
runners_data.comment: Crafty Gael has been knocking persistently on the door, finishing second last time out and third two starts back, and he arrives here on a handy 22-day turnaround with going experience in his favour; the concern is that he remains yet to win in his last five starts.

runners_data.name: Brionywells
runners_data.note: The most compelling recent form in the field — two wins at 20f+ on Good in his last five — and his trainer's 14-day record of 1/4 is modest but his own profile does the talking; a natural hold-up operator who will need traffic to part but the Good ground and stamina-testing trip suit him squarely.
runners_data.comment: Brionywells arrives on the back of two wins in her last five starts, most recently a third last time out, and has run over today's trip and going — her chief risk is whether 164 lb blunts her finishing effort.

runners_data.name: Butchers Bill
runners_data.note: Anthony Day's six-year-old returns after 100 days off and his form string of 5F-P7P includes several pulls and falls; a genuine hold-up horse whose race will be run from the back, though the long absence and patchy jumping record are clear negatives at this distance.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts and pulling up twice in that sequence, Butchers Bill nonetheless heads the ratings and has run over today's trip and going, giving him the profile edge; 100 days off adds a fitness query, but 158 lb is manageable and he remains the one to beat.

runners_data.name: Forest Spirit
runners_data.note: Mickey Bowen saddles his son James to ride this five-year-old, who has placed three times on Good ground over 20f; a natural hold-up type whose best form comes when he gets a clean run, and trainer's 14-day strike of 6/18 is the best stat in the race for connections.
runners_data.comment: Forest Spirit has shown she can mix it at this level, finishing third last time out and a second four starts back, but she remains winless in her last five starts and a hefty 154 lb in the weights is a stiff ask for a mare rated 79.

runners_data.name: Athena's Dream
runners_data.note: The race's sole front-runner and its primary pace-setter, giving Harriet Dickin's four-year-old an unusual tactical advantage; the visor goes on again and she must be respected for setting the fractions, though her style fit score of 0.92 tempers confidence in her winning rather than just controlling.
runners_data.comment: Athena's Dream has shown consistent form without a win in her last five starts, running second last time out and third three starts back, though the fifth two starts back illustrates her inconsistency; she has run over today's trip and going, arrives fresh on 13 days' rest, but 153 lb is a stern test.

runners_data.name: Could Be You
runners_data.note: Neil Mulholland's six-year-old carries a "fades in finish" flag and a form string of P0P9-F that speaks for itself on Good ground; a true hold-up horse pushed into midfield on the map, and the finishing pattern makes this a very difficult winning profile to construct.
runners_data.comment: Could Be You is yet to win in his last five starts, a run that includes two pull-ups and a fall, and he carries 153 lb off an official mark of 78, though our rating of 85 suggests some untapped ability to balance the concern.

runners_data.name: French Diablo
runners_data.note: David Bass, one of the most experienced jockeys in this field, partners Max Comley's four-year-old who won at 22f on Good going and placed at this course type; a prominent racer who should sit comfortably in second or third and is the most likely horse to challenge Athena's Dream in the closing stages.
runners_data.comment: French Diablo won two starts back but has pulled up on his latest outing and once more earlier in the sequence, with a third in between, making consistency the key concern; he has run over today's trip and returns after just 16 days, but his record in recent starts is patchy at best.

runners_data.name: Ramaah
runners_data.note: Sarah-Jayne Davies's five-year-old has three places at 23f on Good in his last five but no win in 15 sim-going runs; a hold-up horse who wears a visor and will need a strong pace to draw off the front, which may not materialise here — 67 days off adds a further question mark.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts and ranked ninth of eleven on our figures, Ramaah is hard to fancy here, though he does bring distance and going experience and has placed three times in recent starts; the 67-day absence and a hefty 150 lb burden add further questions.

runners_data.name: Tis But A Scratch
runners_data.note: Ten-year-old returning after an extraordinary 481-day absence for Georgie Howell, and the form line of 7P/35- shows moderate recent efforts; a genuine hold-up type by nature who must bounce back from the layoff before his tactical position becomes relevant, which is a very large ask.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last four starts and absent for 481 days, Tis But A Scratch faces a stiff ask as the bottom-ranked runner here, though he has run over today's trip and going before and a third two starts back offers a sliver of encouragement.

runners_data.name: Alex The Great
runners_data.note: Tony Carroll's six-year-old (5/48 in 14 days for the trainer) arrives just eight days after his last run and steps up sharply from 12-14f to 22f on Good; form figures of 9-4765 at shorter trips give little confidence he stays this far, making him the most speculative runner in the field.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts and ranked bottom of the field on our figures, Alex The Great makes for a tough sell here; he has run over today's trip and going before, and an eight-day turnaround at least confirms he arrives fit, but a career-best is needed.

races.paceDynamic: Athena's Dream is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 11-runner field and, with no genuine challenger for the lead, she will stride into a clear early advantage under Megan Bevan and set a controlled, honest gallop over 2m7f on Good ground — sustainable rather than pressured, which means the pace is unlikely to be truly searching. French Diablo and Ramaah are the next closest to the pace but neither has the profile or mandate to push Athena's Dream hard, so the tempo will be dictated at a single horse's discretion. This race shape — a lone leader setting a steady-to-fair gallop over a stiff trip — classically suits horses who can sit handy off a comfortable pace and produce a finish, making on-pace prominent racers and hold-up horses with proven finishing ability the primary beneficiaries. It is worth noting that this field contains far more hold-up and mid-division types than the race map can accommodate: Butchers Bill, Forest Spirit, Could Be You, Ramaah, Tis But A Scratch, and Alex The Great are all genuine hold-up horses displaced into the midfield tier on the map, meaning the closing berths will be congested and those runners will not enjoy the unobstructed path their style demands.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Athena's Dream Dictates Unchallenged
scenarios.trigger: If Athena's Dream is allowed to stride clear early and sets a measured, controlled pace that suits prominent raiders over the final mile.
scenarios.body: Athena's Dream bowls along in front without pressure, and the horses positioned just behind her — French Diablo and Brionywells — get a perfect lead to track before challenging; the finish becomes a test of stamina from the front two berths rather than a late sprint.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Strikes Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace set by Athena's Dream is genuine enough that prominent horses fade, allowing a true closer to pick them off.
scenarios.body: With a proper gallop over 2m7f on Good ground, the stiff finish at Worcester can peg back front-runners, and a horse with proven late finishing ability who gets a clean run can arrive powerfully from behind; Brionywells and Crafty Gael both have the Good-ground form over this trip to capitalise.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse — Front Pair Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Athena's Dream effectively goes too steady, creating a slowly-run race where those on her heels have enough in reserve to pull clear.
scenarios.body: A falsely-run race over 2m7f turns the finish into a sprint test that favours tactical speed over stamina, meaning French Diablo — who won over this course and distance — and Athena's Dream herself kick and hold.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Chaos — Pace Scramble
scenarios.trigger: If several of the displaced hold-up horses push forward against their natural style and contest the early lead, creating an unexpectedly strong gallop.
scenarios.body: A contested gallop on Good ground over nearly 3 miles will be punishing for horses racing out of role, and only one with genuine stamina and class above this grade can survive the attrition; Brionywells, with two wins at 20f+ on Good and the most convincing recent form, is best positioned to benefit from such carnage.

watchPoints.text: Athena's Dream sets the pace throughout — watch whether she goes fast enough to string the field out or dawdles, as her tempo will determine every other scenario in this race.

Forest Spirit (James Bowen, trainer 6/18 in 14 days) is a hold-up horse squeezed into the midfield but connections have live claims — monitor his position rounding the final turn for any sign he has found a run.

French Diablo with David Bass aboard is the most dangerous prominent horse if Athena's Dream sets an honest gallop; watch for Bass to take closer order from the third-last hurdle as he did when winning at 22f.
Tis But A Scratch returns after 481 days — watch for any jumping errors early that could interfere with runners immediately behind him in what is a congested midfield.

Brionywells (Nick Slatter, 3lb claim) has the best form over the trip on Going ground but will need a clear run from the back third of the field — watch the top of the home straight for whether he gets daylight.

races.name: CopyBet BOG Now For Doncaster Tomorrow Handicap Hurdle Race (Div I)

runners_data.name: Flawless Clarity
runners_data.note: The confirmed pace-setter here — 340 days off the track is a serious fitness flag, and she has no similar-going win in four attempts at comparable ground; her style fit at 0.93 shows she is racing within role but the layoff tempers confidence heavily.
runners_data.comment: Flawless Clarity has run over today's trip and going, and that third two starts back hints at live each-way claims off a mark of 97, though he is winless in recent starts and the 340-day absence on 168 lb is the chief concern.

runners_data.name: Getaway With You
runners_data.note: Prominent type who handles this trip, ran well enough at 20f on Soft to suggest he gets 2m4f; tongue-tie fitted, yard firing at 1/4 in 14 days, and his recent run 144 days ago is less damaging than Flawless Clarity's absence — most logical prominent challenger.
runners_data.comment: Getaway With You won four starts back and has since posted consecutive fourths, suggesting he retains consistent placed-level form; he has run over today's trip and going, and 166 lb is the chief concern after 144 days off.

runners_data.name: Sweet Honey B
runners_data.note: Runs from the back of the field and has just one recorded run on comparable Good ground from six turf starts; her form string of 56-0 recently is uninspiring and she will need a lot to go right from off the pace.

runners_data.name: Jessie Jump Jet
runners_data.note: A natural hold-up horse who is consistent rather than spectacular — five placed runs from nine on Good ground, two runner-up finishes at 23f and 21f, and a tongue-tie fitted; trainer Drinkwater has a rare current winner (1/1 in 14 days) which is a small positive angle.
runners_data.comment: Consistent place-getter Jessie Jump Jet arrives carrying 160 lb off a 57-day break, with experience of today's distance and going and a rating of 96 suggesting she holds strong claims; the worry is that her last run ended in a sixth, and she remains yet to win in her last five starts.

runners_data.name: Berry Edge
runners_data.note: True hold-up type handled by the powerful Skelton yard, which is running at an excellent 9/25 in 14 days, but her entire form bank is on Soft or Heavy ground — this Good surface is the clearest concern, and she has not run beyond 17f in recent starts.
runners_data.comment: Berry Edge returns after 177 days off the track, which is the primary concern here, and our rating ranks him eighth of ten in this field. He showed he can win in recent starts — a winner two starts back — but a long absence makes him hard to fancy with confidence.

runners_data.name: Harry Gulliver
runners_data.note: A genuine closer by nature, assigned to midfield on the map because the field is packed with hold-up horses who cannot all settle at the rear; he owns a win on Good over 20f and placed twice more in similar conditions, making him the redistribution runner with the most credible form claim.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last three starts, Harry Gulliver arrives on the back of a sixth last time out, though a third four starts back and a winner five starts back hint at ability worth respecting; he has run over today's trip and going, and 150 lb is the one note of caution.

runners_data.name: Sweet Serene
runners_data.note: Won most recently at 18f on Soft and has been off 188 days; placed to midfield on the map despite being a true hold-up type, and the combination of a long break, soft-ground form, and style displacement makes her difficult to recommend.
runners_data.comment: Sweet Serene won last time out but that was 188 days ago, and ranked seventh of ten on our figures she faces a stiff task against stronger company here; she has run over today's trip and going before, which is at least something to cling to.

runners_data.name: At Sunrise
runners_data.note: Five-year-old who has struggled to fire on Good ground (4 placed from 5 similar-going runs, no wins) and will be racing in a position further forward than she ideally wants; the style fit of 0.90 is the lowest in the race alongside Cosmic Spirit.
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last four starts and returning after a 103-day break, At Sunrise does at least have experience of today's going to call upon, though 146 lb is a stern burden and she has pulled up within that recent sequence.

runners_data.name: Noble Recall
runners_data.note: Consistent hold-up horse with three placings from eight runs on similar ground and one win, but carrying a 5lb claimer (Isabelle Ryder) and coming off a pulled-up last run; bumped forward on the map from her natural position at the back.
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts and pulled up most recently, Noble Recall returns after a 96-day absence carrying 143 lb and ranks ninth of ten on our figures — the experience over today's trip and going offers slim consolation, but it is hard to fancy.

runners_data.name: Cosmic Spirit
runners_data.note: A four-year-old flagged as fading in finishes, with a form string showing mostly double-digit finishes on Good ground and no win in the book; even with redistribution to midfield, this profile of dropping away late makes her the least threatening runner in the field.
runners_data.comment: Unexposed and open to improvement, Cosmic Spirit is yet to win in recent starts but remains lightly raced and capable of better; returning after 22 days and carrying 142 lb, he is one to watch as his profile fills out.

races.paceDynamic: Flawless Clarity is the sole confirmed front-runner in this 10-runner 2m4f handicap hurdle, and with no genuine rival willing to push for the lead, she is expected to dictate at a controlled, sustainable gallop on Good ground at Worcester. Getaway With You is the only other horse with a prominent profile, but the remainder of the field — Harry Gulliver, Sweet Serene, At Sunrise, Noble Recall, and Cosmic Spirit — are all true hold-up types who have been redistributed on the map because there are simply too many closers for the race shape to accommodate them all at the rear naturally. Of those redistributed runners, Harry Gulliver and Noble Recall have the clearest form evidence to suggest they could respond if the race develops a late surge, but none of them are guaranteed to settle as far back as their preferred style demands. With Flawless Clarity setting an uncontested, honest-but-not-punishing tempo, this race shape strongly favours horses who can travel prominently or in a close midfield position, picking up the pieces from just off the pace rather than relying on a deep late rally.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Flawless Clarity Controls Cleanly
scenarios.trigger: If Flawless Clarity gets a clean lead and sets a fair but unhurried pace, allowing her to husband her energy through the final bend.
scenarios.body: Travelling comfortably on the front end on Good ground she handles, she dictates every yard and the genuine hold-up horses in behind can never generate the momentum to reel her in from off a slow pace; a prominent racer tracking her closely — Getaway With You — would be best placed to pounce if she weakens.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Challenger Pounces Late
scenarios.trigger: If Flawless Clarity's long layoff (340 days) finds her out of sorts and she weakens from the second-last, leaving a travelling rival to inherit the lead.
scenarios.body: Getaway With You, fresh from a recent run and handled by the Killahena & McPherson yard with a recent 1/4 strike rate in 14 days, is the most likely beneficiary tracking close throughout and picking up decisively; Jessie Jump Jet's consistency on Good ground (5 placed from 9 similar-going runs) gives her a live chance of filling the frame.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Types Finish Fast
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses entering the home straight, compressing the field and giving the real closers one sharp surge to the line.
scenarios.body: Harry Gulliver — a genuine hold-up operator with a course-relevant win at 20f on Good — and Noble Recall, who has placed in 3 of 8 similar-going runs, carry the strongest each-way profiles if the closing kick materialises; however, several of these horses will not have settled as far back as they need, blunting the scenario's true probability.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse, Field Bunches
scenarios.trigger: If an unexpected rival challenges Flawless Clarity for the lead early, lifting the tempo before the race falls apart turning for home.
scenarios.body: An uneven, muddling pace would scramble the race shape entirely, making positioning in the home straight the decisive factor; Berry Edge, trained by Dan Skelton with a powerful 9/25 14-day strike rate, would have the quality support to capitalise if delivered at the right moment, though her soft-ground form profile is a concern on this Good surface.

watchPoints.text: Flawless Clarity's 340-day layoff is the single biggest uncertainty in the race — if she is ring-rusty or blows up early, the entire pace structure collapses and every scenario shifts toward Getaway With You.

Harry Gulliver, Sweet Serene, At Sunrise, Noble Recall, and Cosmic Spirit are all genuine hold-up types who cannot all settle at the back — watch for scrimmaging early as the field jockeys for position through the first mile.

Berry Edge is sent out by Dan Skelton's yard in red-hot form (9/25 in 14 days), but her whole form profile is on Soft or Heavy ground; if she runs flat on Good, do not be surprised — the trainer's form may attract support that the ground evidence does not justify.

Jessie Jump Jet has finished second four times in recent form but cannot win — watch whether she travels more fluently than usual or whether she once again finds one too good, as her positional profile suits this particular pace shape.

Getaway With You's headgear (tongue-tie) and the trainer team's recent 1/4 14-day strike rate are live angles worth tracking in the market — if he drifts, the yard confidence may be tempered; if he firms up, the tactical position tracking Flawless Clarity makes him the race shape's primary beneficiary.

races.name: CopyBet Bog Now For Doncaster Tomorrow Handicap Hurdle Race (Div II)

runners_data.name: Bathara
runners_data.note: A 5yo H-style runner who shapes best fresh on good ground over 2m-plus — 113 days off the track is a concern, but the Jonjo O'Neill team have a solid 14-day record and his sim-going form (5 runs, 1W 3P) is encouraging; needs a trouble-free passage from the rear.|
runners_data.comment: Bathara shaped well with a third last time out and a winner five starts back, and his distance and going experience reads well here; the main query is whether 113 days off the track has left him short of peak fitness, but he heads the ratings and warrants plenty of respect.

runners_data.name: American Empire
runners_data.note: Six-year-old hold-up type in form (ran just 13 days ago), consistent placer on good ground at this trip and shorter, but yet to win in 12 similar-going starts — Theo Gillard takes over and the tongue strap may aid; needs a pace collapse to close.|
runners_data.comment: Yet to score in his last five starts, American Empire at least brings distance and going experience to the table and was third three starts back — and again four starts back — but a trainer strike rate of just five per cent over the past fortnight is the significant concern.

runners_data.name: Ikigai Star
runners_data.note: The lone confirmed front runner; Bass can dictate from the front on a track and going that suits, and the Charlie Longsdon yard is 2-from-3 in a 14-day window — a measured, uncontested lead over 2m4f is his best possible scenario and he must be respected.|
runners_data.comment: Ikigai Star has run over today's trip and going and shaped with promise when third two starts back, but he arrives winless in his last five starts and that 161 lb burden could prove the decisive factor against him here.

runners_data.name: Traveling Soldier
runners_data.note: Hold-up veteran of 8 with visor applied; consistent in placings on good ground over this exact 2m4f trip (five of last five at 20f) but has gone winless in 15 similar-going starts — Sean Bowen is a significant booking that adds confidence, though the record suggests a placer rather than a winner.|
runners_data.comment: Placed in his last two starts, Traveling Soldier arrives after a 50-day absence carrying 157 lb, and with two pulled-up efforts three and four starts back clouding his recent record, he remains winless in his last five; experience over today's trip and going at least offers some grounding.

runners_data.name: Usyk
runners_data.note: Naturally a hold-up horse but the crowded rear forces him into a midfield position he would not normally occupy, which compromises his chance; the 5yo has no win from seven similar-going outings and the style-fit discount (0.92) weighs against him in this shape.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in recent starts yet highly regarded — our rating of 92 puts him second among the nine runners — Usyk returns after 60 days off, handles today's going, and ran a solid third last time out; the refusal two starts back is the one concern connections must overcome.

runners_data.name: Farhh Echo
runners_data.note: Carries a documented tendency to fade in the finish and his form string (P880-P) is alarming — the hold-up tag sits awkwardly in a map where he is pushed into midfield, and with zero wins or places from 12 similar-going runs there is little reason for optimism.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts and twice pulled up in that sequence, Farhh Echo arrives on a testing profile, though he has run over today's going before and our rating of 88 suggests a touch more ability than his official mark implies.

runners_data.name: Dynamite Defense
runners_data.note: The 5yo's true hold-up style is squeezed into midfield by the field's composition, meaning he cannot settle as deep as he would like; has placed third twice on good ground over 2m and the p-headgear may help, but no wins from 15 similar-going starts limits his ceiling here.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last five starts and ranked seventh of nine on our figures, Dynamite Defense is hard to fancy, his recent form featuring a pull-up and an unseating alongside modest finishes; has run over today's trip and going before, and 22 days between runs suggests he arrives fresh.

runners_data.name: Babychino
runners_data.note: Four-year-old prominent type ridden by conditional Fern O'Brien (5lb claim) — two places from 11 good-ground starts suggests some ability, the visor reapplied, and racing second off the front runner is her most natural position; the youth and light weight are assets if she can jump cleanly.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in her last five starts and ranked eighth of nine on our figures, Babychino faces a stiff ask at 145 lb, and a pulled-up effort last time out does little to inspire confidence, though she has run over today's distance and going before.

runners_data.name: Inca
runners_data.note: Eight-year-old with the longest absence in the field (100 days off), consistent mid-division finishes but no wins from six similar-going starts; his true hold-up running style is pushed toward midfield by the field's shape, leaving him trapped with the same pack he has been unable to pass before.|
runners_data.comment: Winless in his last four starts, beaten into fourth on his two most recent outings, and off the track for 100 days, Inca finds this very tough ranked last on our figures, though he has run over today's trip and going before.

races.paceDynamic: Ikigai Star is the sole confirmed front runner here and, with no rival likely to seriously contest the lead, David Bass can dictate a controlled, sustainable gallop from the front over this 2m4f trip on good ground at Worcester. Babychino is the one prominent type capable of sitting just behind, but she is not a natural pace-maker and is unlikely to harry Ikigai Star into a gruelling test. The field is heavily loaded with hold-up horses — Bathara, American Empire, Traveling Soldier, Usyk, Farhh Echo, Dynamite Defense, and Inca all want to race from off the pace — meaning the rear is congested and several of those tagged redistributed (Usyk, Farhh Echo, Dynamite Defense, Inca) cannot all find their true position and will end up racing closer than they would ideally like. With one handler setting a measured pace, this race strongly favours the prominent and hold-up horses with proven finishing ability in similar-paced races, particularly those who can travel sweetly just off the leader and pounce in the home straight — patient hold-up types with a clean turn of foot on good ground are best placed, but the overcrowded rear means true closers face a tactical headache, tilting the edge toward horses that can sit second or third without fighting for position.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Ikigai Star Controls Throughout
scenarios.trigger: If Ikigai Star dictates a steady gallop and kicks clear before the field can organise a sustained challenge.
scenarios.body: Bass settles Ikigai Star in front at his own tempo, the pace never quickens enough to stretch the field early, and the leader has enough left in the tank when the home straight arrives; the good ground suits his course record and the lack of any genuine pace rival means he is never headed. Prominent and patient hold-up horses with finishing pace are next best, but the fractured rear means they struggle to close the gap in time.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Pounces Late
scenarios.trigger: If the pace is just fast enough that Ikigai Star ties up in the final two flights, allowing a well-positioned closer to reel him in.
scenarios.body: Bathara or American Empire, tracking the race from midfield, finds the gallop tempo sufficient to close the gap naturally in the last half-mile and swoops with a clean run; both have good-ground form at this trip and their handlers know this circuit well. The key is that the front runner must be caught slightly flat-footed at the second-last, giving the best finisher room to capitalise.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Prominent Racer Outstays Field
scenarios.trigger: If the early gallop is just brisk enough to stretch the hold-up horses, leaving a prominent or second-placed horse to collar Ikigai Star and outstay the closers.
scenarios.body: Babychino, racing prominently just off the lead, finds a straightforward trip and outlasts any hold-up rival that cannot get through traffic in the straight; the good ground and a clean round of jumping are essential for the four-year-old. This scenario requires Ikigai Star to fade from the front rather than win, and Babychino to jump economically throughout.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Closers Fail, Field Bunched
scenarios.trigger: If the hold-up horses are trapped wide or meet interference in the home straight and the race finishes in a tight cluster.
scenarios.body: With so many genuine hold-up types compressed into midfield and the rear, a scramble for room from the second-last hurdle is plausible; redistributed horses like Usyk or Dynamite Defense are racing out of their natural position and may find themselves hampered or short of room at the crucial moment. In this chaotic finish, the horse best placed to steal a march — likely Ikigai Star or Babychino — benefits most while the true closers pay the price for the congested field.

watchPoints.text: Ikigai Star — if David Bass secures the lead unchallenged in the first half-mile and the gallop remains unhurried, the front runner is the single biggest danger in the race and merits close monitoring throughout.|

Bathara — 113 days off the track is a significant absence flag; watch for any signs of rustiness at the early hurdles or sluggishness on the bend, as his chance is entirely dependent on a clean reappearance.|

Babychino — as the only prominent type behind Ikigai Star, her jumping and positioning in the first mile will shape the whole race; a bad error or wide run could remove her entirely from contention and leave the front runner unopposed.|

Usyk, Dynamite Defense, Farhh Echo, Inca — four hold-up types crammed into an already congested midfield group; watch for traffic and interference issues from the second-last hurdle onward, as a bunched finish could see one or more of these riders unable to find a clear run.|

Traveling Soldier — Sean Bowen is an unusually strong jockey booking for this grade and this trainer; if he positions the horse closer to the pace than the H-style tag suggests, it could signal a change of tactics worth tracking in the early stages.|
